name: Seminara MCP
description: Orchestrates autonomous live presentation sessions, slide synchronization, knowledge base injection, and lead capture for Seminara. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep create_session on Review so an agent cannot provision new presentation sessions or consume account minutes without explicit confirmation.
Keep export_leads on Review so captured attendee contact information and PII cannot be exported without explicit user approval.
Use list_sessions, get_session, and get_session_analytics for read-only inspection of active presentations without modifying state or exposing attendee PII.
